title: American Airlines: A Hold Despite Better Revenue And Lower Debt
Still Looking For A M4 Mac mini? Amazon Has Some Units In Stock For The 16GB RAM & 512GB SSD Variants For $800, But You’ll Have To Be Quick
content: The DRAM shortage and the ability to run AI agents on powerful and affordable computers mean Apple cannot keep up with demand, which is why the company was forced to discontinue the base M4 Mac mini that ships with 256GB of storage, with the other variants also difficult to come by. Fortunately, you’ll come across rare chances to grab one of these compact machines from online retailers such as Amazon, with the 16GB unified memory and 512GB SSD model available for $799.
